title: Experiment-control hardening verification
scope: Verify the bounded correctness-only hardening of experiment-control catalogs, compiler expansion, evidence reconciliation, behavior and outcome materialization, and immutable-input projection without changing runtime mechanisms or releasing measurement.
verification_method: Strict JSON Schema and hash validation; deterministic PowerShell fixture generation, semantic validation, materialization, and projection rebuild; catalog-mutation and ambiguous-rule proofs; content-renaming warning proof; expected-invalid correlation, epoch, release, classification, and projection checks; foundation, compiler, and runtime-evidence regressions; focused Release builds and requirement-home tests; direct SpecTrace model validation; and diff validation.
preconditions: The dirty primary and prior incident worktrees remain preserved.
No reviewed interaction actuation-proof records are assumed.
Measurement, campaigns, transforms, CI, push, active_internal, and production activation remain unauthorized.
procedure: Validate the evolved schemas and three canonical v2 planning catalogs.
Prove exact catalog authority by changing only a catalog mapping and observing changed derivation.
Prove warning results remain identical after fixture rename and differ when filename text lacks matching content.
Reject candidate, applied, configured, forced, shadow, eligibility, run, connection, epoch, release, and classification inconsistencies.
Materialize behavior and non-behavior outcomes separately and reproduce both byte-for-byte.
Prove one-to-many expected behavior expansion, seven relationship types, separated family semantics, and interaction actuation-proof blocking.
Rebuild projection v2 twice from explicit immutable inputs and reject five targeted invalid inputs.
Re-run v1 foundation, compiler, and runtime-evidence validators.
Run focused builds, requirement-home tests, SpecTrace validation, and git diff --check.
expected_result: Catalog-derived behavior, content-derived warnings, complete correlation, separate outcome accounting, set-based planning, explicit relationship and family semantics, interaction proof blocking, and general immutable projection rebuild all validate deterministically while v1 evidence remains compatible and measurement and activation remain frozen.
status_summary: Passed on 2026-07-25 after the focused hardening regression, foundation/compiler/runtime regressions, Release builds, requirement-home tests, direct SpecTrace validation, and diff validation completed without performance, campaign, transform, CI, push, active_internal, production activation, runtime mechanism change, or another-axis migration.
